answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 27587 Country: India Title: Is it allowed for any body to listen to quran when he/she is in a state of Zanabat? Also, is it allowed to listen to quran when any woman is undergoing monthly menstruation cycle? Question: Is it allowed for any body to listen to quran when he/she is in a state of Zanabat? Also, is it allowed to listen to quran when any woman is undergoing monthly menstruation cycle? Answer ID: 27587 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1805/1312/L=1431) Listening the recitation of the holy Quran in the state of Janabah or menstruation is not forbidden. A junubi (person in the state of impurity) or menstruating woman can hear the recitation of the holy Quran. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
